description: Earn with JOBFLOW, the office software for trade and service businesses: get the signup link for a business owner. Three plans after 30 days free: Starter CHF 69, Business CHF 129, Wachstum CHF 299 a month (founder price 30 % less for 12 months); you earn 30 % of every paid month for 12 months (40 % for the first 100 partners), paid to your principal's Stripe account. Disclose the commission; the owner signs up and subscribes themselves. Needs a key.
